'''Platform 3DC/Green''' was a [[Type I Light-Duty Space Platform]] located near an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] that was operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as an emergency repair facility, though it was registered as a civilian volunteer rescue station with [[Bureau of Ships and Services/Legends|BoSS]] as a cover for its Alliance activities. Damaged [[Starship/Legends|starships]] would be patched up enough that they could return to battle or make it back to their home base. Facilities on the station included [[The Airlock]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], and the [[Blue Nova]], a [[Cantina/Legends|tavern]].<ref name="H&S" />
